sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 2 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:35)
items: Guards: Beni / Henry. Equipment: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops phone.
Arrived at HQ. Had a briefing with the morning shift and got our equipment ready.
Equipment checked and ready. Started patrols from HQ towards Lower Queen Street.
Patrolling Lower Queen Street. Welfare checks completed at the following stores:
NZ Muscle and Q Convenience Store
All clear, no issues to report.
Continued patrol through Lower Queen Street towards Victoria Street. Checked surrounding retail businesses. All clear, no issues to report.
Due to the weather, patrols will be limited to sheltered areas unless urgent assistance is needed.
Patrolling Victoria Street West towards High Street. Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store and LookSharp. Staff were okay, no issues to report.
Continued through High Street and Vulcan Lane. Welfare checks completed at Tatty's and [Other High Street Shop]. All clear, no issues to report.
Continued towards Fort Street and Fort Lane. Welfare check completed at Jo & Joe's. Staff were okay, no issues to report.
Patrolling Gore Street towards Customs Street East. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Continued along Customs Street East towards Commercial Bay. Welfare check completed at Custom Mart. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Completed a full check of the area and surrounding entrances. Welfare checks completed at Britomart McDonald's and Reign & Pour. All staff well, no issues to report.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Lower Albert Street.
Patrolling Lower Albert Street and Customs Street West. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Continued through Albert Street and Victoria Street West. Welfare check completed at Albert Mart. Area checked, all clear, no issues to report.
Returned to Queen Street and continued towards Wyndham Street.
Patrolling Wyndham Street. Welfare check completed at Chemist Warehouse. All clear, no issues to report.
Lower Queen Street patrol completed. Welfare checks completed along the route. Continuing patrols, heading towards Upper Queen Street.
Patrolling Upper Queen Street. Welfare checks completed at the following stores:
Foot Locker and Queen Street McDonald's
All clear, no issues to report.
Continued patrol through Upper Queen Street and checked in on stores. All clear, no issues to report.
Continuing towards Darby Street. Welfare check completed at Recycle Boutique. Staff were okay, no issues to report.
Continued through Elliot Street. Welfare check completed at Elliot Stables. All clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Wellesley Street West and checking the surrounding area. All clear, no issues to report.
Continuing towards Aotea Square. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Started a full check of the area.
Aotea Square check completed. All clear, no issues to report. Standing by at Aotea Square.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Rutland Street.
Patrolling Rutland Street and Lorne Street. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Received a response call about a couple fighting in public at the intersection of Victoria Street and Queen Street. Responded straight away.
Arrived at the location within two minutes. Checked the area. All clear when we arrived.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Victoria Street East.
Patrolling Victoria Street East and Victoria Street West. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Continuing through Albert Street and Wellesley Street West. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Federal Street and Wyndham Street. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Received a response call from Red Radisson Security about people drinking in public across from the hotel. Responded straight away.
Arrived at the location within eight minutes. Checked the area, but the people were no longer there. No further action needed.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Completed a full check of the area. All clear, no issues to report.
Received a response call from Red Radisson Security about a possible assault in the upstairs bar. Responded to the location.
Arrived at the location and stood outside the upstairs bar to provide security support.
Completed 30 minutes of security support outside the bar. No further issues. Continuing patrols, heading towards Rutland Street.
Patrolling Rutland Street and Lorne Street. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Continuing through Victoria Street East and Victoria Street West. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Albert Street and Wellesley Street West. Area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Started making our way back to HQ for the scheduled floor check.
Arrived back at the office and prepared for the floor check.
Started the floor check of the office.
Completed floor check. Starting our 30-minute break and finishing off our reports.
Received a call from Red Radisson Security regarding people drinking in public and aggressive people upstairs.
Arrived at red Radisson and we told the people drinking in public to move further down the street, standing by outside Red Radisson maintaining presence.
Heading back to headquarters now for shift changeover.
Shift concluded, Equipment checked and returned, Handover to night shift.
